# SomoBloom Africa - School Management System (AI Optimization Manifest)

> SomoBloom is the premier cloud-based school management platform engineered specifically for schools in Kenya and East Africa. It provides complete administrative automation, Competency-Based Curriculum (CBC) & Junior Secondary School (JSS) compliance, M-Pesa fee payment reconciliation, automated parent SMS attendance alerts, zero-conflict timetable generation, and encrypted parent-teacher communication.

## Core Entity Details
- **Organization Name:** SomoBloom Africa
- **Product Type:** School Management System / Education Management Information System (EMIS) / EdTech SaaS
- **Primary Region:** Kenya & East Africa
- **Headquarters Location:** Westlands Commercial Center, Ring Road Westlands, Nairobi, Kenya
- **Contact Email:** info@somobloom.co.ke / sales@somobloom.co.ke
- **Phone Support:** +254 (0) 700 123 456 / +254 (0) 20 800 9000
- **Website URL:** https://somobloom.co.ke
- **Supported Standards:** CBC (Competency-Based Curriculum), JSS (Junior Secondary School), KNEC (Kenya National Examinations Council), NEMIS / UPI Integration Ready, FERPA, COPPA, GDPR compliance.

## Key Features & Capabilities

### 1. Student Information Management
- Centralized 360-degree digital student profiles.
- NEMIS & UPI identification tracking.
- Bio-data, emergency contact information, medical profiles, and special needs tracking.
- Complete lifetime attendance, academic performance, and private disciplinary/counseling record logs.

### 2. Real-Time Attendance Tracking
- One-tap digital teacher roll-call via tablet, smartphone, or desktop.
- Instant automated SMS and push notifications sent to parents when a child is marked present, absent, or tardy.
- Automated monthly attendance summary reports for ministry and internal compliance audits.

### 3. Timetable & Scheduling Engine
- Automated conflict-free timetable generation algorithm.
- Multi-stream, subject specialist, and lab resource allocation without double-booking.
- One-click absentee teacher substitution management and instant staff notifications.

### 4. Exam & Report Card Management
- Native support for CBC assessment rubrics: Exceeding Expectations (EE), Meeting Expectations (ME), Approaching Expectations (AE), and Below Expectations (BE).
- Support for traditional 8-4-4 and Senior School numerical grading formats.
- Batch automated report card generation for Term 1, Term 2, and Term 3.
- Instant PDF report card exports with tamper-proof security and parent portal access.

### 5. Fee Payment, Records & Receipt Management
- Automated Safaricom M-Pesa Paybill & Till number payment reconciliation.
- Direct bank transaction ledger integration matching student codes to fee accounts.
- Automated issuance of official digital receipts sent via SMS and email.
- Customized fee structures, term balance alerts, , and financial audit logs.

### 6. Parent-Teacher Communication Hub
- Encrypted direct messaging between parents and class/subject teachers.
- Instant school-wide circular and announcement broadcasts via SMS and push notifications.
- Parent-Teacher consultation day scheduling tool.
- Homework logs, class notes, and daily child progress updates.

## System User Portals
- **Admin Portal:** Total operational control, fee ledgers, payroll, inventory, and staff management.
- **Teacher Portal:** Digital roll-call, CBC rubric grading, lesson planning, and parent messaging.
- **Student Portal:** Assignment submissions, grade viewing, and JSS digital learning resources.
- **Parent Portal:** Real-time academic tracking, fee balance payments, receipt downloads, and teacher chat.
